item.title: Kubernetes Dashboard Streamlined Deployment: Resolving Privilege Deficits and Implementing Dual Token & Kubeconfig Authentication
item.description: A comprehensive walkthrough on deploying the Kubernetes Dashboard add-on with local registry image substitution and NodePort exposure. Solves official default ServiceAccount privilege limitations via cluster-admin ClusterRoleBinding, detailing both Bearer Token extraction and automated Kubeconfig credential generation.
